source: Read-only DOM inspection of the existing user Chrome tab 988955508 via Codex browser client
finalContainerObservation: Each of the six containers exists once; only balance-sheet is visible. Other open report views are retained hidden.

periodControls.D01: Two visible ant-select controls, both showing 2022年第01期; separate page-size and ledger selects also exist.
periodControls.D04: Single visible ant-select period control. Dropdown uses virtual-list options titled YYYY年第MM期. Dynamic rc_select IDs are not stable selectors.
periodControls.D05: periodInnerSelect shows 2022年第01期 ~ 2022年第01期. Opening reveals periodInnerSelect-drop with two nested initially blank ant-select controls. Separate column mode shows 本月数、本年累计数.
periodControls.D06: periodInnerSelect shows 2022年第01期 ~ 2022年第01期. Opening independently confirms periodInnerSelect-drop with two initially blank nested ant-select controls and no confirmation button.

limits: The range selector was exercised with the original 2022-01..2022-01 values; no accounting periods or business data were changed.
Native fixed navigation implementation is tested on isolated synthetic pages, not through an installed paired Xiaojing extension.
Visible menu, ledger name and period text do not replace actual request accountId, scope and response qualification.

cashRangeSelection.followupControlAttributes: The D06 outer range renders its selected range in ant-select-selection-placeholder text, not a selection-item title. ArrowDown on the focused outer combobox opens the nested range. The product inspector supports these observed attributes.
cashRangeSelection.keyboard: End did not move the active option. ArrowUp from the first option (2025年第10期) wrapped to the last (2022年第01期); active option was independently read before Enter.
cashRangeSelection.startOnly: Selecting start 2022-01 leaves end blank in the nested control and sends no cash-report query.
cashRangeSelection.completed: Selecting end 2022-01 closes the range dropdown and sends the query. A subsequent fixed Refresh sends the same fields.
cashRangeSelection.qualification: Explicit expanded scope is distinct from the earlier gatherType-only initial scope; no missing-field defaults or equivalence assertion added.
